title: Standing foot X-ray for flat feet
what: X-rays of your feet while standing, with your body weight on them. From them, the doctor measures the height of your arch.
why: For possible flat feet, foot pain, a military medical board, or to choose insoles.
duration: usually 10 to 15 minutes in the room; the report the same or the next day
tell_doctor: If you are or might be pregnant
If you had foot injuries or surgery

prepare.title: Prep
prepare.text: None needed. You can eat and drink.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: You will need to take off socks or tights and roll your trousers up to the knees.

bring: Past foot X-rays, if you have them
steps: You take off your shoes and socks
You stand on a special platform with weight on both feet
A side image is taken of each foot
Sometimes an image from above is added
Stand straight and keep still for a couple of seconds
feel: You need to stand straight. Hold the handrail, if there is one
after: You can go about your day right away
The report usually gives angle measurements. Take it to an orthopedic doctor

faq.q: Why is the X-ray taken standing?
faq.a: Flat feet show under body weight. Lying down, the arch looks normal.

faq.q: Is this X-ray accepted for a military medical board?
faq.a: Usually yes, but check their requirements in advance.

reminders.text: Foot X-ray soon. Wear trousers that are easy to roll up to the knees.
